title: AI Engineer Intern (x/f/m) - Paris
description:
Join a team of passionate and committed people working to improve healthcare.

At Doctolib, our tech teams build products and features that improve the daily lives of healthcare professionals and patients. We work in feature teams within an agile environment, in close collaboration with Product, Design, Data Science, and Business teams.

What you'll do

We are looking for an AI Engineer Intern to join our Tech team and contribute to the development of AI-powered features at Doctolib.

You will work closely with experienced AI and software engineers to explore, prototype, evaluate, and improve AI-based solutions. This internship will give you the opportunity to gain practical experience across the different stages of an AI product, from experimentation to integration into a production environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Contribute to the development of AI features and services under the guidance of experienced engineers

  • Write Python code to support prototypes, experiments, evaluation tools, and backend components

  • Experiment with large language models, prompting techniques, retrieval, and tool integration

  • Contribute to automated tests and documentation for the components you develop

  • Investigate issues, analyse results, and suggest improvements to your team

  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and team rituals

You will receive regular guidance from your mentor and teammates. The scope of your work will grow progressively as you become familiar with the codebase, the tools, and the technical challenges.

Who you are

Before you read on, if you do not have the exact profile described below but feel that this internship matches your skills and interests, we still encourage you to apply.

You will be a great fit if you:

  • Are in the final year of a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field

  • Have basic experience with Python through coursework, personal projects, research, or previous internships

  • Have a basic understanding of programming concepts, data structures, and software development

  • Are curious about artificial intelligence and interested in understanding how AI systems work

  • Are comfortable communicating in English, both written and spoken

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have worked on a project involving machine learning, natural language processing, or large language models

  • Have used agentic frameworks like Langchain or Google ADK.

  • Have experimented with AI APIs, prompting, retrieval, or conversational interfaces

  • Have experience in taking products to production and supporting them with real users.

  • Have some experience with Git, APIs, testing, or data analysis

  • Have an interest in healthcare, privacy, or responsible AI

Life at Doctolib Tech

Our products are built on a cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile applications across several countries and healthcare systems.

Even if Doctolib uses technologies like Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Swift, React Native, and many cloud-related technologies, the principal language you'll work on is Python.You will also have the opportunity to use AI-assisted development tools within our engineering practices.

Discover our AI vision here and learn more about our tech culture on the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • A structured internship with dedicated mentoring

  • The opportunity to work on real AI projects in a healthcare environment

  • Technical learning sessions and access to internal engineering communities

  • Access to AI tools for coding, development, and learning

  • Meal vouchers

  • Free breakfast in the office

  • Up to 2 days of remote work per week

  • A flexible workplace policy, depending on the team and location

  • A collaborative and international working environment

The interview process

  • Coding Game

  • Recruiter Interview

  • Technical Interview

  • Behavioral Interview

Job details

  • Internship, 6 months, full-time

  • Location: Berlin, Paris, Nantes, Milan, or Amsterdam

  • Hybrid work setup, up to 2 remote days per week

  • Start date: March 2027

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. We evaluate candidates based on their qualifications, motivation, and potential, without discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the better our products can serve patients and healthcare professionals. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability, or place of origin.

To support an inclusive recruitment process, we invite you to leave personal information such as pictures and age off your application. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please let us know.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided through this application is processed by Doctolib for recruitment purposes. For more information about how Doctolib processes your application data, please consult the relevant privacy policy:

  • Germany

  • France

  • Italy

  • The Netherlands

For questions or to exercise your rights, please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com.

title: Data Engineer Intern
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.


Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.


About the role
The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models.
 
As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers.
 
We are looking for a motivated student or recent graduate with a background in computer science, data science or a related field and a solid foundation in Python and data processing, available to start in early 2027. 

What you will do

Data pipeline

  • Get to know how data is collected, stored, processed and labelled at Gravis today, map the current data flows, and suggest ways to improve them

  • Explore the data pipeline and orchestration tools available today (e.g., Dagster, Flyte, Argo Workflows, Airflow, Ray Data) and compare them against our requirements: data volume, multimodal sensor data, CPU and GPU processing steps, reproducibility and ease of use

  • Help build small prototypes of the most promising options and test them on real fleet data, from raw machine recordings to training-ready datasets

  • Work with our infrastructure team to set up the chosen pipeline on Kubernetes, so that it runs reliably on our on-premise and cloud clusters

  • Help add data versioning, quality checks, lineage and monitoring, so that engineers can trust every dataset and trace where it came from

    • Collaboration and sharing

  • Write up the trade-offs and present your recommendation to the team

  • Document the pipeline and help ML and robotics engineers start using it


    • What we're looking for

    We recognise that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.

    Core qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Master's programme in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field in a Swiss university 

  • Solid Python skills and hands-on experience with data pipelines or data-heavy applications, from coursework, a thesis, side projects or a previous internship

  • Good working knowledge of data processing fundamentals: batch and streaming processing, columnar file formats (e.g., Parquet), and SQL databases

  • Familiarity with Docker and working in a Linux environment

  • Comfortable with open-ended problems where the answer is not known yet, and able to compare technical options and explain your reasoning, both in writing and in front of a team

    • Nice to have

  • Experience with a workflow orchestrator (e.g., Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, Flyte, Argo Workflows)

  • Experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Ray, Spark, Dask)

  • Experience with Kubernetes

  • Experience working with robotics or sensor data (point clouds, camera streams, time-series data) and formats such as ROS bags or MCAP

  • Experience with data versioning or dataset management tools (e.g., DVC, lakeFS)


    • This role is a great fit if…

  • You are eager to apply your academic knowledge to real-world problems, and to see your work having an impact on actual machines

  • You want to contribute to a foundational data pipeline that helps our machines improve faster

  • You thrive in a hands-on environment where you learn new tools by trying them out on real data

  • You are curious about machine learning and about how training datasets are built

  • You value a collaborative culture built on thoughtful design, creative problem-solving, mutual respect, and pragmatism

    • Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

    We are an international team working to solve problems with global impact. To facilitate efficient communication and collaboration, proficiency in English is a requirement for all roles.

title: Junior Data & AI Engineer (Finance)
description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Finance Junior Data & AI Engineer

Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands | Duration: (12 months)

About the role

The Finance AI team sits within the Prosus finance organisation and supports the function in reimagining finance through AI. We partner with finance teams to build and deploy impactful AI transformation projects, at scale.

You will join the team as a hands-on Junior Data and AI Engineer. You will help build and maintain the data pipelines that power our AI solutions, and get your first taste of the "intelligence layer" on top: retrieval systems (RAG) and agentic workflows that automate financial analysis. You will work alongside experienced engineers who will guide your work and help you take on more ownership as you grow.

It is a practical role with real projects, real data and direct exposure to finance teams who use what we build.

What you will do

1. Data pipelines and infrastructure

  • Help build and maintain cloud-based data lake and pipelines using Databricks and following established patterns and team standards.

  • Help develop efficient data pipelines for ingesting, processing, and storing large datasets, incorporating best practices for data quality, lineage tracking, and metadata management - specifically optimized for LLM consumption.

  • Implement data quality checks, monitor pipeline health and help fix issues as they arise.

2. RAG and agentic workflows

  • RAG & Agentic Systems: Contribute to RAG components (chunking, embeddings, retrieval) and help test improvements such as hybrid search and re-ranking to handle dense financial documents and tables.

  • Agentic Workflows: Help build agent workflows using LangGraph and Databricks Agents, with design guidance from senior colleagues.

  • Evaluation: Support the evaluation of AI outputs with "LLM-as-a-Judge" frameworks (MLflow) to quantify accuracy, faithfulness, and latency.

  • Follow security and privacy guidelines so that AI outputs comply with financial regulations and privacy standards.

  • Help maintain and document reusable "Agent templates" that empower Finance business partners to build their own safe AI-driven workflows.

3. Collaboration and enablement

  • Work closely with AI teams and key stakeholders across finance to understand data requirements for AI systems and ensure their smooth deployment.

  • Document your work and share what you learn with the team.

  • Help finance colleagues use our tools and templates for data tasks.

  • Take part in day-to-day workflows with business functions to ensure prompt and high-quality data movement from source systems to production.

  • Follow security, privacy and data governance guidelines (including GDPR) in everything you build.

What you bring

  • 1-2 years of experience with a focus on data lake and cloud infrastructure, with an interest in GenAI (RAG, agents or LLM-integrated apps).

  • Hands-on exposure to building data pipelines in cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, or GCP). Databricks experience is a plus.

  • Good working knowledge of SQL and Python or another programming language to develop custom automation scripts, tables, and solutions. You should be comfortable using AI-native IDEs like Cursor/claude code to accelerate development and refactoring.

  • Experience with MCP servers to expose databases and local tools to LLMs, and with REST/GraphQL/FastAPI for building the deterministic "hooks" that AI agents call.

  • A structured, methodical approach to problem-solving and the willingness to learn how to troubleshoot.

  • Clear communication in English and the confidence to ask questions and work with technical and non-technical colleagues.

  • Based in the Netherlands with the right to work here.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of metadata systems and data lineage tracking tools.

  • Exposure to a cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).

  • Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).

  • An affinity for machine learning engineering or an intention to further develop skills in this area.

  • Experience with data warehousing concepts and platforms like Snowflake, Google BigQuery.

  • A basic understanding of financial concepts and an interest in helping finance colleagues adopt self-service tools.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

title: AI Engineer (Perception) H/F
description:
At Marso, as an AI Engineer focused on perception, you will develop the models that let the Marso robot understand its environment: detecting, locating and tracking loads, obstacles and people in warehouses. You will own the full lifecycle of perception models from data quality and training to production reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, train and evaluate embedded perception models: object detection, segmentation, pose estimation and scene understanding.

  • Fuse data from multiple sensors (cameras, depth sensors, lidar, IMU) to deliver robust perception in real operating conditions.

  • Define and measure data quality for perception and automate dataset extraction and labeling from field logs.

  • Make sure models stay reliable through every deployment stage from PoCs and field tests to production, including changes in lighting, loads and sites.

  • Optimize models for embedded hardware to meet latency and compute constraints while maintaining the output quality.

  • Set up standardized evaluation and regression testing so that every model release is measurably better.

  • Build internal tools to visualize and debug sensor data, predictions and model performance.

Profile

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering focused on computer vision or 3D perception, ideally in robotics or autonomous systems.

  • Strong command of Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or equivalent).

  • Hands-on experience with 2D and 3D perception: detection, segmentation, pose estimation, point clouds or multi-sensor fusion.

  • Experience deploying perception models to production under hardware constraints.

  • Solid understanding of data pipelines: collection, cleaning, labeling and quality measurement.

  • Nice to have: experience with ROS/ROS2, camera and lidar calibration, synthetic data generation, C++ or perception for logistics environments.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background.

Chez Marso, en tant qu'AI Engineer spécialisé en perception, vous développerez les modèles qui permettent au robot Marso de comprendre son environnement : détecter, localiser et tracker les charges, les obstacles et les personnes dans les entrepôts. Vous serez owner de tout le cycle de vie des modèles de perception, de la data quality et du training jusqu'à la fiabilité en production.

Responsabilités

  • Développer, entraîner et évaluer des modèles de perception embarqués : object detection, segmentation, pose estimation et scene understanding.

  • Fusionner les données de plusieurs capteurs (caméras, capteurs de profondeur, lidar, IMU) pour une perception robuste en conditions réelles d'exploitation.

  • Définir et mesurer la data quality pour la perception, et automatiser l'extraction de datasets et le labeling à partir des logs terrain.

  • Garantir la fiabilité des modèles à chaque étape du déploiement, des PoC et field tests jusqu'à la production, y compris face aux variations d'éclairage, de charges et de sites.

  • Optimiser les modèles pour le hardware embarqué afin de respecter les contraintes de latence et de compute sans dégrader la qualité des résultats.

  • Mettre en place une évaluation standardisée et des tests de non-régression pour que chaque release de modèle soit mesurablement meilleure.

  • Développer des outils internes pour visualiser et débugger les données capteurs, les prédictions et les performances des modèles.

Profil

  • 4 à 6 ans d'expérience en AI/ML engineering, orienté computer vision ou perception 3D, idéalement en robotique ou sur des systèmes autonomes.

  • Excellente maîtrise de Python et des frameworks de deep learning (PyTorch ou équivalent).

  • Expérience hands-on en perception 2D et 3D : detection, segmentation, pose estimation, point clouds ou fusion multi-capteurs.

  • Expérience du déploiement de modèles de perception en production sous contraintes hardware.

  • Bonne compréhension des data pipelines : collecte, nettoyage, labeling et mesure de la qualité.

  • Nice to have : expérience avec ROS/ROS2, calibration caméra et lidar, génération de données synthétiques, C++ ou perception en environnement logistique.

Nous sommes engagés dans la construction d’une équipe diverse et inclusive. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées sont les bienvenues et nous accordons une attention particulière aux compétences, à l’impact et à la capacité à contribuer au projet.

Compensation: €50K – €80K

title: DevOps/ML Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
At Machine Learning Reply, we work with our customers on cutting-edge projects for which we are looking for DevOps and ML Engineers to support our customer projects around machine learning and data processing across various industries. To expand our team, we are looking for a talented and highly skilled consultant with a technical background to join our team. As a consultant, you will be responsible for providing expert advice and technical support to our clients.

If you're a DevOps or ML Engineer or just starting out in the field of machine learning and/or DevOps engineering - if you never lose focus, love coding, data and AI, and are passionate about bringing your ideas to life - then we want to hear from you!


Responsibilities:

  • Design innovative, technical approaches for data intensive and applications with a focus on machine learning and artificial intelligence.

  • Implement and take ownership for your solutions on in either cloud based (AWS, Azure or GCP) and/or on-premises infrastructures of our customers.

  • Automate recurring tasks by state-of-the-art DevOps and MLOps concepts, enabling your customers to significantly reduce their time-to-delivery.

  • Take care of the necessary monitoring, failover, and recovery infrastructures that allow our customers save operation of their machine learning solutions in agreement with latest regulatory requirements

  • Closely interact with customers and stakeholders to translate concrete and complex business requirements into production-ready solutions

  • Collaborate with various disciplines such as enterprise architects, analysts, data scientists or data engineers to develop data-intensive applications such as data warehouses, data lakes and/or data platforms


What we offer you:

  • Access to work on projects across industries (large and mid-market companies in Banking, Insurance, Automotive, Retail, etc.)

  • Broaden your skills through interdisciplinary work and training in the areas of data engineering, cloud architecture, and data science

  • Benefit from industry-leading cooperations in the cloud, BI, and AutoML field

  • Very active social program - including training, conferences, team buildings, Reply Exchange, communities of practices, and hackathons

  • Work in an open, flat environment, within a broad Reply knowledge-sharing network

  • Award-winning office space in downtown Munich with access to “Stammstrecke”

  • You choose your state-of-the-art equipment

  • Public transport ticket with Deutschlandticket

  • Gym-membership subsidy for a gym of your choice

  • Flexible work environment between client, Reply office, and remote work


Minimum Job Requirements / Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s / master’s degree in computer science or any other related fileds (e.g. engineering, statistics, physics).

  • First practical experience with DevOps/MLOps principals and computing platforms like Microsoft Azure, AWS and GCP as well as Databricks.

  • Ability to convincingly communicate and present analytical results to management.

  • We cover the full lifecycle of Data, from Cloud Infrastructure, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and Visualization to ML Engineering to and MLOps. Interest and/or experience in some of those fields is an advantage.

  • Fluent in English and German.


Desired:

  • Working experience in cloud technologies (AWS, Azure or GCP), Kubernetes and programming languages like Python, Java and Scala.

  • Practical experience with SQL and NoSQL database technologies and data lakes

  • Experience with big data technologies (Apache Spark), data streaming (Apache Kafka) and workflow orchestration (Apache Airflow, Dagster)

title: AI Engineer (Manipulation) H/F
description:
At Marso, as an AI Engineer focused on manipulation, you will develop the models that let the Marso robot pick, handle and place real-world loads reliably in customer warehouses. You will own the full lifecycle of manipulation models from data collection and training to on-robot evaluation and production deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, train and evaluate learning-based manipulation models (pick and place, palletization) that run on the Marso robot.

  • Explore and apply approaches such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning and vision-language-action models.

  • Build the data loop for manipulation: teleoperation or demonstration collection, curation, labeling and dataset extraction from field logs.

  • Integrate models with perception, motion planning and control, working with the Intelligent Robotics and Embedded Software teams.

  • Make sure models stay reliable on the robot and in the field: standardized evaluation, failure analysis and robustness to new loads and environments.

  • Optimize models for embedded deployment (latency, quantization, hardware constraints).

  • Use simulation and real-world tests together to speed up iteration and close the sim-to-real gap.

  • Build internal tools to visualize, replay and debug manipulation behavior and model performance.

Profile

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering applied to robotics, including hands-on work on robot manipulation.

  • Strong command of Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or equivalent).

  • Practical experience with at least one of: imitation learning, reinforcement learning or vision-language-action models for manipulation.

  • Experience deploying models on real robots, including under hardware constraints.

  • Solid understanding of manipulation fundamentals: kinematics, grasping, motion planning and control.

  • Nice to have: experience with ROS/ROS2, C++, physics simulators, teleoperation setups, force/torque sensing or logistics applications such as palletization or depalletization.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background.

Chez Marso, en tant qu'AI Engineer spécialisé en manipulation, vous développerez les modèles qui permettent au robot Marso de saisir, manipuler et déposer de manière fiable des charges réelles dans les entrepôts de nos clients. Vous serez owner de tout le cycle de vie des modèles de manipulation, de la data collection et du training jusqu'à l'évaluation on-robot et au déploiement en production.

Responsabilités

  • Développer, entraîner et évaluer des modèles de manipulation learning-based (pick and place, palettisation) qui tournent sur le robot Marso.

  • Explorer et appliquer des approches comme l'imitation learning, le reinforcement learning et les modèles vision-language-action.

  • Construire la data loop de la manipulation : collecte par téléopération ou démonstration, curation, labeling et extraction de datasets à partir des logs terrain.

  • Intégrer les modèles avec la perception, le motion planning et le contrôle, en collaboration avec les équipes Intelligent Robotics et Embedded Software.

  • Garantir la fiabilité des modèles sur le robot et sur le terrain : évaluation standardisée, analyse des échecs et robustesse face à de nouvelles charges et de nouveaux environnements.

  • Optimiser les modèles pour le déploiement embarqué (latence, quantization, contraintes hardware).

  • Combiner simulation et tests en conditions réelles pour accélérer les itérations et réduire le sim-to-real gap.

description:
DATA SCIENTIST (H/F)

STAGE MASTER II - 6 mois

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

Qui sommes-nous ?
Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact.

Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.

Contexte du stage

Les LLMs (Large Language Model) sont des outils efficaces, rapides à prendre en main et généralistes, ce qui en fait un choix technique facile pour une grande partie des projets de traitement du langage naturel. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ».

Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Ils sont extrêmement coûteux en énergie, coûteux en eaux, coûteux financièrement et ils nécessitent d’importants investissements (création de Data Centers) pour être mis en place.

Dans une volonté de contrôle des données produites et utilisées par l’entreprise (et plus largement de toutes données privées), il est important de garantir que les données traitées soient protégées, ce que l’usage de certains LLMs ne garantit pas. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie.

Par ailleurs, le monde de l’IA connaît une période d’incertitude, avec une course effrénée vers des modèles généralistes de plus en plus gros et de plus en plus gloutons en espace comme en énergie. Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons nous orienter vers des méthodes plus « frugales ». Nous souhaitons ainsi de préférence adapter de petits modèles à des tâches très précises, qui ont l’avantage d’être plus parcimonieux. Un axe principal du travail sera donc de construire des modèles dont la création sera standardisée, avec un minimum de paramétrage à effectuer, et moins de labellisation manuelle à fournir. Nous souhaitons proposer une méthode qui soit la plus générique possible (voir en appui sur les approches MCP/ADK). Les questions clés sont de déterminer s’il est possible de répertorier, créer et tester des modèles pour nos cas d’usages, et de quantifier le gain énergétique de ces modèles en comparaison avec d’anciennes techniques présentes dans le groupe.

Votre mission :

L’objectif principal du stage est de produire un benchmark et une analyse complète des outils de Data Science proposés par Explore. Ce travail sera complété par une bibliographie des domaines dans lesquels s’inscrivent les solutions proposées.

Enfin, ce stage est prévu pour aboutir à une thèse CIFRE, et l’étudiant.e sera encouragé.e à participer à la rédaction du sujet de thèse.

Des déplacements ponctuels au L3i de La Rochelle seront également prévus.

Les livrables attendus pour ce stage sont :

• Un état de l’art des approches existantes et de l’état des technologies utilisées par Explore

• Un benchmark de ces approches sur des données de l’entreprise

• Une publication scientifique résumant tout ce travail.

 

Ce stage sera rémunéré à hauteur de 1000€ mensuel.

Informations importantes

ð  Ce stage sera suivi d’une thèse CIFRE d’une durée de trois ans, financée par le groupe Intescia ;

ð  Ce stage est co-encadré entre le laboratoire L3i de La Rochelle Université et Explore, filiale du groupe Intescia.

 

Le L3i (Laboratoire Informatique, Image et Interaction) est le laboratoire de recherche en informatique de La Rochelle Université, créé en 1993 et labellisé Équipe de Recherche Technologique. Il rassemble une centaine de membres, dont 32 enseignants-chercheurs, une trentaine de doctorants et 7 personnels permanents de soutien à la recherche, répartis en trois équipes : « Dynamique des systèmes et adaptativité », « Images et contenus », et « Modèles et connaissances ». Il dispose d’une expertise reconnue internationalement autour de l’analyse et de la compréhension de documents, notamment administratifs.

 

Les encadrants du côté laboratoire sont : Antoine Doucet et Mickael Coustaty.

Du côté Explore : Julie Queiros, avec une participation ponctuelle du manager de l’équipe, Steven Hellec.

  

• Les étapes du recrutement seront les suivantes :

  •    1er entretien avec Julie QUEIROS, DATA SCIENTIST chez Explore, accompagnée du personnel encadrant du laboratoire ;

  •    2ème entretien et restitution de cas pratique avec Julie, accompagnée de son N+1 Steven HELLEC, ainsi que des encadrants du laboratoire ;

  •    3ème et dernier entretien avec l’équipe RH, pour tout formaliser.

Le profil que nous recherchons

  •       Étudiant·e de Master 2 dans les domaines suivants : Informatique / Mathématiques Information / Statistiques / Traitement du langage naturel / Data Science. 

  •       Appétence à la recherche 

  •       Connaissances en : Python, SQL, Méthodes de NLP  

  •       Maîtrise de l’anglais 

  •       Qualités de rédaction, d’analyse et d’autonomie appréciées.

Ce que nous vous offrons :

  • Poste basé à Carquefou

  • Carte tickets restaurants

  • Option de télétravail ou flexibilité pour une meilleure organisation de votre quotidien

title: AI Engineer
description:
Do you thrive on complex problems and want to work at the forefront of AI? Join Cefetra Group’s new AI Innovation Hub as an AI Engineer and shape how AI creates value across our international trading business, from agents and workflows integrated with our core systems to the skills and ways of working that make them stick.

Who we are

Cefetra Group comprises several trading companies in the agricultural sector and the food ingredients industry, with leading brands in the ingredients market. Together, we employ approximately 800 people across 39 offices in 17 countries worldwide. We work closely together to provide our customers with the best possible service. Together with our suppliers, we develop strong supply chains and create value by sourcing raw materials and supplying them to the international food, animal feed and energy industries. Behind that sits real complexity: global commodity flows, volatile markets, intricate contracts and logistics, and data spread across many entities and systems. That is exactly where AI can make a decisive difference, and we are building the capability to make it happen.

The role

As an AI Engineer in the AI Innovation Hub, part of the Group Digital & Technology team, your goal is to build Cefetra Group’s AI capability and set the standard for how AI is designed and used across our entities. You’ll deliver AI solutions, from agents and workflows to knowledge bases, that teams across Cefetra Group can apply to augment their work, while helping colleagues build the skills to use them. You’ll work directly with process owners and business leaders to find where AI creates the most value. The AI Innovation Hub is just getting started, so together with the Group Digital & Technology team you’ll shape its direction from the ground up: which opportunities it pursues and how it delivers them. You’ll also work with Builders and Changemakers, colleagues in our entities who build AI solutions and drive adoption, to share what works and show business leaders what AI makes possible.

Your responsibilities include

  • Run discovery workshops to identify bottlenecks, value and exceptions. Assess use cases against readiness, team commitment, expected value and reuse potential.

  • Build AI workflows and agents using company data. Take prototypes all the way to robust, production-grade solutions that teams rely on in their daily work.

  • Integrate AI solutions with ERP, finance and operations systems, designing integrations that move safely from read-only access to controlled write-back.

  • Test solutions against real business scenarios. Set the deployment patterns, tool choices and safeguards that others across Cefetra Group build on.

  • Deliver hands-on workshops, from practical AI topics such as Claude Skills for non-technical colleagues to technical topics such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Builders and create materials Changemakers can use to train their peers.

  • Prepare demos of working use cases for leadership briefings.

Who you are

To succeed at Cefetra Group, you love complexity and combine deep technical curiosity with a pragmatic, collaborative approach. You work well both independently and with people at all levels of Cefetra Group. You take ownership end to end and move easily between governance, technical details and business priorities. You also meet the following requirements:

  • You have at least four years of experience in a technical, customer-facing, consulting or product role.

  • You’ve built and evaluated large language model (LLM) workflows, agents or applications in production.

  • You have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, indexing, knowledge bases, context engineering and orchestration.

  • You follow AI developments closely, from new models to agentic patterns and protocols, and know how to turn new capabilities into practical value.

  • You have full-stack development experience with Python or TypeScript, including APIs, authentication, data transformation and enterprise integrations.

  • You’re fluent in English and have led workshops for non-technical audiences.

What we offer

A unique opportunity to help Cefetra Group grow and become part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial team within an established multinational. We’re always open to discussing your individual needs. Here’s what we offer.

  • Access to frontier AI models and the room to experiment with new tools, techniques and ways of working.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working, as well as opportunities to learn and develop.

  • An excellent remuneration and benefits package, including a competitive base salary, holiday allowance, an attractive bonus scheme and 28 days of annual leave.

  • An office in one of the finest locations in central Rotterdam, overlooking the Maas and the Erasmus Bridge, with plenty of social activities and excellent coffee.

If this sounds like you

Interested in a conversation to further explore and enquire? Please apply below and we will contact you a.s.a.p. Or contact via +31 6 2520 3984 or

Recruitment, consulting other temp/secondment agency?

We appreciate the interest, but we seek all our candidates directly. We understand that you would like to present your candidates our interesting positions, but this is not how we have structured our recruitment process. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered will be treated as direct applications to our vacancies.

  • Créer des tableaux de bord et des rapports pour industrialiser et communiquer les résultats de vos analyses de manière claire et concise

  • Proposer des recommandations basées sur les résultats obtenus 

  • Participer à la présentation interne et externe de vos analyses

Vous travaillerez dans cet environnement technologique :

  • Ad-Hoc / Exploration:  Metabase et DataGrip en SQL

  • BI / Reporting: Tableau

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si :

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en cours de formation dans le domaine de l'informatique, des statistiques, des mathématiques appliquées ou tout autre domaine connexe

  • Vous avez une bonne maîtrise des outils d'analyse de données tel que SQL

  • Vous savez travailler de manière autonome et savez gérer efficacement les délais

  • Vous avez de fortes compétences analytiques et capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes

  • Vous avez de bonnes aptitudes en communication écrite et orale

  • Vous avez un intérêt pour la santé publique

 

Notre offre

  • Un programme d’onboarding complet, avec la Doctolib Academy et de nombreuses sessions de formation au sein de votre équipe (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

  • Une carte Swile et de nombreuses offres de restauration au sein de nos locaux 

  • Une offre de sport : un abonnement Urban Sports Club, des cours de sport gratuits dans les bureaux ou à distance

  • Le remboursement des titres de transport à 50%

  • De nombreux bureaux offrant des espaces de collaboration et de bien-être 

  • Une politique de travail flexible avec un mode hybride

 

Le processus de recrutement

  • Un entretien Flore, Talent Partner (15 minutes) 

  • Un entretien opérationnel avec Brice, eHealth Product Strategist Manager (45 minutes)

  • La restitution d’un cas pratique avec Brice et un autre membre de son équipe (1 heure) 

 

Détails du poste 

  • Stage conventionné à temps plein

  • Lieu de Travail : Levallois-Perret

  • Gratification : À définir selon niveau d’études

 
 

Chez Doctolib, nous sommes convaincus que nous devons améliorer la santé pour tout le monde. Cela se reflète dans notre processus de recrutement. Nous évaluons les candidatures uniquement sur la base des qualifications et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Plus les idées sont diverses, plus notre produit améliorera véritablement la santé pour tout le monde. Vous pouvez postuler chez Doctolib, quel que soit votre genre, religion, âge, orientation sexuelle, origine ethnique ou handicap.

title: Full-Stack Developer - Next.js & Python
description:
Full-Stack Developer – Next.js & Python

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer to build and maintain production web applications across a modern frontend, backend, database, and cloud stack.

This is a hands-on development role for someone who can own a slice of the product across both UI and API. You’ll work with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, relational and graph databases, multi-service architecture, real-time functionality, and Azure infrastructure.

What You’ll Own

Frontend Development

  • Build production web applications using Next.js 16 with App Router, React 19, and strict TypeScript.
  • Work with server/client boundaries and data-fetching using TanStack Query or equivalent.
  • Build interfaces using Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui + Radix, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, and AG Grid Enterprise.
  • Work with Framer Motion and Socket.IO.
  • Write frontend tests using Vitest + Testing Library.
  • Build end-to-end tests using Playwright.

Backend Development

  • Build and maintain backend services using Python 3.13 and FastAPI.
  • Work with Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2 / SQLModel, Alembic, Celery, Redis, and uv.
  • Work with typed schemas, async I/O, authentication, and background jobs.
  • Work within a multi-service codebase using HTTP between services, Redis, and workers.

Database & Data

  • Work with relational modeling and migrations using SQLAlchemy/Alembic or equivalent.
  • Work with Azure SQL (MSSQL) and PostgreSQL.
  • Work with Neo4j for family / heirship graphs.
  • Work with PostgreSQL + pgvector.
  • Work with MongoDB for logs.

Cloud & Operations

  • Work with Azure services including Blob, Identity, Key Vault, SQL, and Container Registry.
  • Work with Docker Compose.
  • Work with Prometheus / Grafana.
  • Work with pnpm workspaces + Turborepo.

Advanced Features & Integrations

  • Work with graph databases or non-trivial graph UIs such as trees, canvases, XYFlow/D3/canvas.
  • Work with complex data UIs including AG Grid, maps, PDF viewers, and rich text using Tiptap.
  • Work with real-time technologies such as Socket.IO / WebRTC or telephony platforms such as Telnyx or similar.
  • Work with LLM/RAG features including embeddings, pgvector, and tool-using assistants.
  • Work with chatbot services; you do not need to be an ML engineer.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 6+ years shipping production web apps.
  • 3+ years as the person who owns a slice across UI and API.
  • Strong TypeScript and React experience.
  • Comfortable with App Router, server/client boundaries, and data-fetching using TanStack Query or equivalent.
  • Strong Python and FastAPI experience, or Django/Flask at a similar depth.
  • Experience with typed schemas, async I/O, authentication, and background jobs.
  • Strong relational modeling and migration experience using SQLAlchemy/Alembic or equivalent.
  • Experience with MSSQL or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience in a multi-service codebase with HTTP between services, Redis, and workers, not only a single monolith.
  • Tests as a habit: unit/integration on the backend and component tests on the frontend.
  • Clear written communication.
  • Ability to leave the next engineer a module they can change without a walkthrough.

Strongly Preferred

  • Graph databases such as Neo4j or non-trivial graph UI using trees, canvases, XYFlow/D3/canvas.
  • Azure experience with SQL, Blob, Key Vault, or a comparable cloud.
  • Experience with complex data UIs such as AG Grid, maps, PDF viewers, or rich text using Tiptap.
  • Real-time experience with Socket.IO / WebRTC or telephony with Telnyx or similar.
  • LLM/RAG experience including embeddings, pgvector, and tool-using assistants.

Nice-to-Haves We Actually Use

  • WebRTC calling.
  • DocuSign / PKCS#7 signing.
  • GEDCOM.
  • Google Maps.
  • Campaign/inbox graph models.
  • Prometheus metrics.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You have extensive experience shipping production web applications and owning a slice across both UI and API.
  • You’re comfortable working across TypeScript/React and Python/FastAPI.
  • You can confidently reason about relational modeling, migrations, and multi-service architecture.
  • You’re comfortable working with Redis, workers, and HTTP communication between services.
  • You treat testing as part of development rather than something to add later.
  • You communicate clearly in writing.
  • You leave the next engineer with a module they can change without a walkthrough.

What Success Looks Like

  • You can independently own a slice of the product across UI and API.
  • Production features are supported by appropriate backend and frontend tests.
  • Relational models and migrations are reliable and maintainable.
  • Multi-service communication, Redis, and workers operate effectively.
  • Complex data UIs and graph-based functionality are implemented effectively where required.
  • Real-time, cloud, and third-party integrations work reliably.
  • Your code is clear enough for the next engineer to understand and modify without a walkthrough.

Tech Stack

Frontend

  • Next.js 16 (App Router)
  • React 19
  • TypeScript (strict)
  • Tailwind CSS v4
  • shadcn/ui + Radix
  • TanStack Query
  • Zustand
  • React Hook Form + Zod
  • AG Grid Enterprise
  • Framer Motion
  • Socket.IO
  • Vitest + Testing Library
  • Playwright

Backend

  • Python 3.13
  • FastAPI
  • Pydantic v2
  • SQLAlchemy 2 / SQLModel
  • Alembic
  • Celery
  • Redis
  • uv

Data

  • Azure SQL (MSSQL)
  • Neo4j (family / heirship graphs)
  • PostgreSQL + pgvector
  • MongoDB (logs)

Cloud & Operations

  • Azure (Blob, Identity, Key Vault, SQL, Container Registry)
  • Docker Compose
  • Prometheus / Grafana
  • pnpm workspaces + Turborepo

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection

title: Software Engineer, Clinical AI Devices
description:
Job Summary

In the Clinical AI Devices team, the Software Engineer is primarily responsible for building and maintaining software in the Clinical AI domain, from wrapping deep learning models into containerized medical devices, to integration with other systems. This work spans all of the company's medical devices, across the main radiology modalities: X-Ray, CT, MRI, and Mammography. The focus of the current role is at the interface between product logic and the underlying serving platform, ensuring that requests are correctly validated, routed, and that results are properly assembled and returned.

 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Participate in the software development process: design, refine, and develop new features, and maintain existing ones.

  • Write code, review teammates' code, and contribute to the testing framework through automated and manual tests. Work with the team lead and product manager to refine requirements.

  • Own features and projects end-to-end, from refinement to production. Flag risks and bugs by keeping the radiologist's workflow in mind. Support service and delivery teams with production issues.

  • Ensure compliance with Quality and Regulatory requirements throughout the development cycle, including technical documentation (e.g. implementation specs), cybersecurity processes, and risk analysis.

  • Collaborate with the team on strategic recommendations and improvements to technology and business.

    PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a related field such as computer science, biomedical engineering or similar (required).

  • Experience (required): at least 5 years of experience in a similar or related relevant role

  • At least 5 years of experience working with Java, with proficiency in Spring Boot (required).

  • Fluent in English (required).

  • Accustomed to CI/CD practice (required).

  • Familiar with test-driven development and testing frameworks like JUnit (required).

  • Experience working with docker, cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, and Kubernetes (required).

  • Experience working with Agentic Coding tools like Claude and Cursor (preferred).

  • Experience working with microservices and distributed systems (preferred).

  • Experience in the MedTech field, e.g. working with DICOM data, AI algorithms, and clinical workflows (preferred).

 

What we value

  • Strong analytical mindset.

  • Not afraid of working inside a strong regulatory framework and disciplined about testing needs.

  • Ability to make well-reasoned trade-offs between velocity and quality, understanding when to work for higher quality and when to optimize for time-to-market.

  • You collaborate openly, support your colleagues, and contribute to shared success. 

 

 Quality Standards

  • Communicate, cooperate, and consistently function professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrate initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercise confidentiality in all areas of performance. 

  • Follow all local, regional, and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follow all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follow data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

  • Practice universal safety precautions.

  • Promote good public relations on the phone and in person.

  • Adapt and willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

  • Report to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meals and rest breaks, and maintain satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Complete job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

 

Working Environment

Hybrid, remote-friendly

Based in France (we have offices in Paris and Grenoble) or in the Netherlands (we have offices in Rotterdam and Amsterdam)

 

Salary:
Dependent upon experience:

60,000-80,000 EURO

title: Software Engineer .NET & Platform (m/w/d)
description:
Software Engineer .NET & Platform (m/w/d)

Über Everfield

Everfield kauft, entwickelt und skaliert europäische Softwareunternehmen aus vertikalen Märkten und Spezialnischen und gibt ihnen die Werkzeuge an die Hand, um den nächsten Schritt zu gehen. Unsere Mission ist es, Ambitionen zu fördern, Wachstum anzutreiben und Chancen für das europäische Software-Ökosystem zu eröffnen.

Die Unternehmen im Everfield-Ökosystem folgen einem dezentralen Modell: Sie behalten ihr Team, ihre Marke und ihre Standorte und konzentrieren sich auf das, was sie am besten können – Produkte entwickeln und Kunden betreuen. Everfield unterstützt in den Bereichen Talent Acquisition und HR und bietet Zugang zu einem Expertenteam für den Aufbau und das Wachstum europäischer B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen, das zu finanziellen und operativen Themen berät. Everfield wurde 2022 gegründet und ist mit seinem Ökosystem bereits in 7 Ländern vertreten – Tendenz steigend.

Über uns

myCompanee betreibt eine Multi-Tenant-SaaS-Plattform für Kantine, Vending und POS – mit rund 180 Produktiv-Tenants und über 750 Containern.

Deine Aufgaben

Du entwickelst die .NET-Services hinter der Plattform weiter und übernimmst Verantwortung für den Betrieb im eigenen Docker-Swarm-Cluster.

Die Rolle passt zu dir, wenn du Backend-Entwicklung und Infrastruktur nicht trennen willst: Du schreibst den Code, deployst ihn und siehst in Grafana, wie er läuft.

• Weiterentwicklung der tenant-spezifischen .NET-Services: Business-Logik (Guthaben, RFID, QR), POS-Anbindung, Zahlungsabwicklung (VR Pay, SEPA, Kreditkarte) und Online-Vending

• Pflege und Ausbau des API-Gateways (Ocelot) inklusive Tenant-Routing und JWT-Validierung

• Arbeit am Identity-Service (IdentityServer4 / OIDC) und Begleitung einer möglichen Migration auf einen aktuellen Nachfolger

• Entwicklung von Echtzeit- und Benachrichtigungsfunktionen mit SignalR, Push-Notifications und E-Mail

• Integration von Geräten und Partnern: Kassen, Vending-Automaten (EVIS-Protokoll), Zahlungsanbieter

• Betrieb, Skalierung und Härtung des Docker-Swarm-Clusters bei Hetzner, inklusive Onboarding neuer Tenants

• Pflege der Datenschicht: MySQL 8.0 mit Replikation und über 180 Tenant-Datenbanken, Redis, RabbitMQ

• Logging, Monitoring und Alerting mit Elasticsearch, Prometheus und Grafana

• Unterstützung bei der Modernisierung: Flutter-Rewrite der Mobile-App, Ablösung von Legacy-Komponenten

Unser Tech Stack

• Backend: C# / .NET, ASP.NET Core, Ocelot API-Gateway, IdentityServer4 (OIDC, JWT), ASP.NET Identity, SignalR

• Frontend & Backoffice: Blazor, Python/Flask mit gunicorn, jsreport

• Mobile: Flutter (Rewrite), Xamarin (Legacy), Azure Notification Hubs

• Messaging & Cache: RabbitMQ (AMQP), Redis (Cache, Pub/Sub, Sessions)

• Datenbanken: MySQL 8.0 (Master/Replica), SQLite

• Infrastruktur: Docker Swarm, nginx, Hetzner Cloud, Docker Hub

• Observability: Elasticsearch 7, Prometheus, Grafana, cAdvisor, node-exporter, Slack-Alerting

• Integrationen: VR Pay, SEPA, EVIS, Kassensysteme

Dein Profil:

Das bringst du mit

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit C# und ASP.NET Core

• Erfahrung mit verteilten Systemen und Microservices, idealerweise mit API-Gateways und Message Brokern (RabbitMQ)

• Solides Wissen zu relationalen Datenbanken, bevorzugt MySQL, inklusive Performance-Tuning und Replikation

• Praxis mit Docker und Container-Orchestrierung

• Verständnis von OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect und JWT-basierter Authentifizierung

• Sicherer Umgang mit Linux, nginx, TLS und Netzwerkgrundlagen

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) und gutes Englisch

Pluspunkte

• Erfahrung mit Multi-Tenant-SaaS-Architekturen

• Erfahrung mit Zahlungsanbietern, Kassensystemen oder Geräteanbindungen

• Kenntnisse in Angular, Blazor, Python/Flask oder Flutter

• Erfahrung mit IdentityServer4 oder Duende IdentityServer

• Branchenbezug zu Gemeinschaftsverpflegung, Kantine oder Gastronomie

Was wir bieten

• Echte Ende-zu-Ende-Verantwortung: vom Code über das Deployment bis zum Monitoring

• Ein Produkt mit realem Einsatz in Kantinen, an Kassen und Automaten

• Gestaltungsspielraum bei der Modernisierung von Architektur und Legacy-Komponenten

• Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem kleinen Team

title: Embedded Controls Software Engineer
description:
At DeWarmte, we develop technology that helps homes move away from gas. Our heat pumps combine hardware, embedded control software, cloud services and data – and the quality of the software connecting those elements directly determines how well our products perform in customers’ homes.


We are looking for an experienced Embedded Controls Software Engineer to develop and evolve the software that operates our heat pumps and, increasingly, a broader range of connected energy devices. As part of our Control & Data team, you will work directly on production software, refine control algorithms, improve product performance and help shape the next generation of our embedded software platform.


This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of software, hardware, control engineering and energy systems. You will work on technology that is already operating in customers’ homes while building the technical foundations for future products and use cases.

Your mission

Build reliable, efficient and extensible control software that enables our products to operate intelligently in an increasingly connected and flexible energy system.
You will inherit working software already deployed in the field. Your job is to understand it deeply, maintain and improve it, and progressively evolve its architecture to support new products, control strategies and regulatory requirements.
Together with the Lead Controls & Data Engineer and our Hardware R&D team, you will help build an embedded software platform that can scale with DeWarmte’s ambitions.

What you will do

Maintain and improve our control software

  • Work directly in the production code that controls our heat pumps.

  • Design, build, test and deploy new control functionality.

  • Develop, refine and validate control algorithms to improve product performance, stability, safety, energy efficiency and customer comfort.

  • Use operational data and real-world measurements to understand product behaviour and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Diagnose complex behaviour across software, electronics, sensors, hydraulics and the physical installation.

  • Improve automated testing, simulation, observability and release practices.

  • Help ensure reliable operation of both newly developed products and our existing installed fleet.

Evolve our embedded software platform

  • Contribute to the architecture and technical evolution of our on-device software stack.

  • Gradually migrate our existing Python-based control software to a compiled systems programming language, with Rust as the preferred direction.

  • Improve software maintainability, runtime reliability, resource efficiency and testability while preserving proven control behaviour.

  • Develop and extend our over-the-air (OTA) software update mechanisms, enabling reliable and controlled software deployments across our connected device fleet.

  • Contribute to the development of our next-generation embedded hardware configuration, working closely with our Hardware R&D colleagues on hardware-software integration and platform design.

  • Establish clear interfaces and reusable software components that allow the platform to evolve without unnecessary complexity.

Expand our control capabilities

  • Extend our control software to support new devices, product configurations and energy management use cases.

  • Develop control strategies that respond to external signals, dynamic energy prices, grid constraints and demand-side flexibility opportunities.

  • Translate evolving regulatory requirements and interoperability standards into robust, testable software functionality.

  • Develop interfaces that enable our products to interact with external energy management systems, other connected devices and third-party services.

  • Help balance energy efficiency, customer comfort, equipment longevity and flexibility in our control strategies.

Work across the product

You will collaborate closely with colleagues in hardware, software, data, product development, assembly, installation and service. You will help resolve immediate customer and operational issues while protecting the long-term quality of our software platform.

You will actively contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, documentation and shared engineering practices, ensuring that our software can be understood, maintained and evolved by the entire team.

What success looks like in your first month

  • You develop a solid understanding of our existing heat pump control software, development workflows and embedded environment.

  • You become familiar with the physical behaviour of our products and the interfaces between software and hardware.

  • You actively contribute to day-to-day software development, debugging and maintenance.

  • By the end of your first month, you are able to independently drive the development of new control functionality, with support from the wider team where needed.

In the following months

  • You take increasing technical ownership of our on-device control software.

  • You independently design, implement, test and deploy improvements to our control algorithms and functionality.

  • You contribute to measurable improvements in product reliability, performance and software quality.

  • You help define and validate the architecture for migrating our Python-based control software to a compiled language.

  • You begin extending and improving our OTA software update mechanisms.

As the role develops

  • You drive the progressive migration of our control software towards a modern, robust and maintainable systems programming stack.

  • New control functionality can be delivered predictably and safely across our installed fleet.

  • You contribute to the design, development and validation of our next-generation embedded hardware and software platform.

  • Our control software supports an increasingly diverse range of devices, regulatory requirements, interoperability standards and energy management use cases.

  • Critical software components are well documented, thoroughly tested and understood by more than one engineer.

  • You become a key technical contributor to the evolution of DeWarmte’s control software platform.

What we are looking for

Essential experiences and skills

  • Several years of hands-on software engineering experience, ideally at mid- to senior level, including experience with production systems.

  • Practical experience developing, implementing and validating control algorithms for physical products, machines or energy systems.

  • Practical experience with HVAC systems, thermal energy systems or controllable energy assets in the context of demand-side flexibility, including an understanding of their physical behaviour and operational constraints.

  • Experience developing software in embedded or hardware-connected environments.

  • Hands-on experience with a modern systems programming language such as Rust or Go. Extensive experience with C, C++ or comparable low-level languages is also relevant, provided you are willing and able to transition to a modern systems programming stack.

  • A good working knowledge of Python and the ability to understand, maintain and evolve an existing Python codebase.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals, including version control, automated testing, code reviews and CI/CD workflows.

  • The ability to reason across software, hardware and physical-system behaviour and systematically diagnose complex problems.

  • Comfort working with modern LLM-based and agentic software development tools and workflows, while maintaining a high standard of engineering quality, code review and verification.

  • The ability to take functionality through the complete development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, deployment and real-world operation.

Additional valuable experience

  • Embedded Linux development, particularly experience with Yocto or Buildroot, custom system images and embedded Linux deployment workflows.

  • Direct experience developing control software or control algorithms for heat pumps.

  • Experience with OTA software updates, connected-device fleet management and reliable software deployment to remotely operated devices.

  • Familiarity with industrial or energy-sector communication protocols, interoperability standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Experience with simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing, control system modelling or optimisation.

  • Experience with front-end paradigms and languages, whether web-based or native, preferably using modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks.

We do not expect you to bring experience in every one of these areas. We value strong software and control engineering fundamentals, intellectual curiosity and the ability to quickly develop a deep understanding of complex physical products.

How you work

  • You take ownership of problems from initial investigation through to implementation, validation and deployment.

  • You enjoy working at the intersection of software and the physical world and are interested in understanding why a system behaves the way it does.

  • You solve urgent problems without allowing permanent workarounds to become the architecture.

  • You balance pragmatic improvements today with the technical investments needed to scale tomorrow.

  • You use modern development tools, including AI-assisted and agentic workflows, to work effectively without compromising reliability or your understanding of the software.

  • You explain complex technical matters clearly to people with different backgrounds.

  • You share knowledge by default and build software that other engineers can intuitively understand, easily test and safely change.

  • You are comfortable switching between debugging a specific installation, refining a control algorithm and developing the architecture for our next generation of products.

What you will get

  • Direct influence on technology that contributes to the energy transition.

  • Ownership of software that sits at the heart of a real physical product.

  • The opportunity to work on challenging problems at the intersection of embedded software, control engineering and energy systems.

  • The opportunity to shape the transition towards a modern embedded software platform

  • A role that starts deeply hands-on and grows into broader technical ownership and architectural responsibility.

  • Close collaboration with colleagues across the complete product lifecycle.

What we offer

  • A monthly gross salary between €4.500 and €6.000, based on full-time.

  • 27 vacation days plus 8% holiday allowance.

  • Participation in our SAR (Stock Appreciation Rights) programme.

  • Plenty of ownership and responsibility from day one.

  • The opportunity to shape products that directly contribute to the energy transition.

  • A talented, ambitious, and highly collaborative team.

  • A healthy daily lunch at the office.

  • Laptop and everything you need to do your best work.

  • Regular team events, company drinks, our annual beach day, and winter trip.

  • Lots of room to grow, develop yourself, and make a lasting impact.

Interested?

Do you want to build intelligent control software for real physical products and help shape the next generation of connected, energy-efficient heating and energy systems?

We would like to meet you!

Compensation: €4.5K – €6K per month

description:
Alle reden von Digitalisierung – Wir machen es. Als Hersteller von Europas #1 CRM/CX-Plattform entwickeln wir innovative Softwareprodukte in den Bereichen Kundenbeziehungsmanagement, Marketing Automation und Machine Learning. Unternehmen bei der Digitalisierung und der konsequenten Kundenzentrierung zu begleiten, ist unsere Leidenschaft. Wir lieben modernste Technologie, Handwerk und Innovation. Du auch? Du übernimmst von der Beratung bis zur Umsetzung den Lead in Kundenprojekten und führst diese erfolgreich zum Go-live. Dabei implementierst du kundenspezifische Lösungen mit Fokus auf LowCode/ZeroCode.
Du bringst dazu Freude an SaaS-Produkteinführungen beim Kunden mit und verfügst über technisches Know-how in modernen Software- und Integrationslandschaften.

Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, Hamburg, München / ab 1. Oktober 2026  / 80 - 100%

title: Software Engineer (Fleet) - London
description:
About Us

At Teton, we are redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology. Facing a global nursing shortage, our solutions offer vital support to overburdened health systems. With thousands of patient rooms across 4 countries already benefiting from our technology, we are aiming to expand to much more. We distinguish ourselves by focusing relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, rapidly deploying solutions that make a real difference.

The Job

Every patient room we deploy into puts another device on infrastructure we don't control, in a building we can't easily visit, running software that has to keep working. We're looking for an Engineer to own that problem: the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that let us ship to thousands of edge devices confidently and understand what they're doing once they're out there.

In this role, you will focus on the following areas of interest:

  • Fleet Management: Build and run the systems that provision, monitor, and manage our devices in the field, from first boot in a hospital room to end of life.

  • OTA & Release Engineering: Own how software gets onto devices: staged rollouts, health checks, automatic rollback, and the confidence that a bad release won't take down a ward.

  • Observability: Design the telemetry, logging, and alerting that tell us a device is degrading before a nurse notices. Make remote debugging possible so we don't fly to fix things.

  • Device Bring-Up & Debugging: Work with our hardware and firmware teams on new hardware revisions, reproduce field issues on the bench, and get to the bottom of problems that span kernel, driver, network, and application.

  • Infrastructure & Tooling: Build the CI/CD, image builds, and internal tools that let the whole engineering team ship to hardware quickly and safely.

  • Documentation: Maintain clear and detailed documentation of your work to ensure easy collaboration and knowledge sharing within the team.

Qualifications:

  • Solid experience running Linux systems in production: ideally embedded or edge Linux, not just cloud VMs.

  • Proficiency in Rust and/or Javascript/Typescript and/or Python

  • Experience with device fleets at scale: provisioning, OTA update mechanisms (Mender, RAUC, balena, or something you built yourself), and remote access to constrained devices.

  • Familiarity with Linux internals: systemd, kernel modules, device tree, networking stack, containers.

  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar) and designing what to measure, not just wiring up dashboards.

  • Comfortable with hardware debugging: serial consoles, working alongside hardware engineers

  • Understanding of communication protocols and how devices talk to each other and to us: I2C, SPI, UART, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, MQTT.

  • Pragmatism about networks you don't control: restrictive hospital IT, VLANs, proxies, flaky Wi-Fi, and long offline periods.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

  • Experience with the NVIDIA Jetson platform and Linux for Tegra is a big plus.

  • Experience with Yocto, Debian packaging, or custom image builds is a plus.

  • Experience in the medical device or healthcare technology field is a plus.

What We Offer

  • Participation in our warrant program (stock options).

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

  • A role where you can make a significant impact on healthcare delivery.

Join Our Team

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job. At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work. If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.
