title: Customs & Trade Compliance Subject Matter Expert (Mexico)
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking experienced customs and trade compliance professionals to support a project focused on Mexican import/export regulations, tariff classification, and customs compliance.

This project involves reviewing realistic customs scenarios, documenting how experienced professionals approach complex regulatory decisions, developing expert reference solutions, and validating technical analyses. The resulting expert materials will support the development and evaluation of advanced AI systems for professional workflows.

This is flexible, project-based consulting work intended for professionals who are actively practicing or have recent hands-on experience in Mexican customs and trade compliance.

Project Details:-

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor / Project-Based (Flexible, Part-Time)

Location: Remote (Mexico)

Compensation: $12/hr

Scope of work: 10 hrs-12 hrs Weekly

What You’ll Do

  • Review realistic import and export scenarios involving Mexican customs regulations.

    • Develop expert reference solutions for customs classification and trade compliance tasks.

    • Document the reasoning behind customs decisions and regulatory interpretations.

    • Review and validate alternative solutions for technical accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.

    • Identify missing information, incorrect assumptions, or inappropriate decision sequences.

    • Reference applicable regulations where appropriate (e.g., Ley Aduanera, LIGIE, TIGIE, NOMs, RRNA, T-MEC).

    • Collaborate with our project team to ensure expert knowledge is accurately represented.

    Required Qualifications

    • 3+ years of recent, hands-on experience in customs brokerage, tariff classification, trade compliance, import/export operations, or a related field.

    • Current or recent (within the past two years) practical experience with Mexican customs regulations and procedures.

    • One or more of the following professional backgrounds:

    • Licensed Agente Aduanal

    • Clasificador Arancelario

    • Trade Compliance Specialist

    • Customs Compliance Specialist

    • Import/Export Compliance Professional

    • Customs or Trade Consultant

    • Professional fluency in Spanish.

    • Ability to clearly explain and document the reasoning behind regulatory and classification decisions.

    Preferred Experience

    Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

    • Tariff classification (Clasificación Arancelaria)

    • LIGIE / TIGIE

    • T-MEC / USMCA

    • NOMs and RRNA

    • Customs valuation

    • Rules of origin

    • Pedimentos

    • VUCEM

    • Customs audits or trade compliance reviews

    Experience using official Mexican customs resources (e.g., ANAM, SAT, SNICE, VUCEM) is preferred. Experience with commercial customs software is welcome but not required.

    Working proficiency in English sufficient to understand project instructions and communicate with the project team.

    Knowledge of U.S. customs regulations, HTS classification, or cross-border Mexico-U.S. trade operations is a plus.

    Why This Project Matters?

title: Medical Coding Auditor -  Evaluation & Management
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Evaluation & Management (E/M) Auditor is responsible for conducting comprehensive audits of provider documentation and coding across multiple medical specialties to ensure compliance with payer, regulatory, and organizational requirements. This role reviews E/M services and minor procedures for accuracy, appropriate code selection, and documentation integrity while identifying coding trends and educational opportunities. The auditor serves as an expert in E/M coding guidelines, specialty-specific documentation requirements, and industry regulations, including CMS and AMA.

The auditor analyzes audit findings, provides coding education feedback to providers, and supports compliance and quality improvement initiatives. This position requires strong analytical skills, in-depth knowledge of professional fee coding across diverse specialty areas, and the ability to interpret complex clinical documentation. Working with a high degree of independence, the E/M Auditor makes informed decisions, applies regulatory guidance to ambiguous situations, and collaborates with operational, clinical, and compliance teams to promote coding accuracy and revenue integrity.

The Medical Coding Auditor is responsible for validating the accuracy and compliance of CPT coding assignments through detailed reviews of medical documentation and coding practices. This role identifies trends and opportunities for improvement. The auditor applies extensive knowledge of coding guidelines, regulatory requirements, and organizational policies to support quality, compliance, and operational objectives.

The Medical Coding Auditor exercises independent judgment in evaluating coding accuracy, resolving coding discrepancies, and addressing complex or occasionally ambiguous situations. Working with minimal supervision, the auditor follows established procedures while supporting continuous improvement efforts through data analysis, audit findings, education, and collaboration with coding, compliance, and operational teams.

title: Customer Support Supervisor
description:
Mayflower is an international technology company behind products used by millions of people worldwide. For more than 10 years, we've been growing profitable global businesses, bringing together talented professionals across technology, product, marketing, and operations.

We are looking for a Customer Support Supervisor to join our growing Technical Support team. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience in investigating platform bugs and incidents, troubleshooting technical issues, and communicating with customers.

The company offers an excellent working environment, a competitive remuneration package, and the chance to work for a developing international company.

Job Responsibilities

  • Investigate complex technical issues and help agents identify and reproduce bugs.

  • Ensure high-quality technical escalations, including clear bug reports and relevant diagnostic information.

  • Communicate with Engineering and Product teams, ask the right technical questions, and follow up on unresolved issues.

  • Identify recurring technical issues, perform root cause analysis, and improve troubleshooting guidelines.

  • Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and develop agents’ technical troubleshooting skills

  • Oversee daily team operations, manage workload distribution, monitor SLA compliance, and ensure timely resolution of technical issues.

Job Requirements

  • Hands-on experience in Software QA, Manual Testing, or a technical support role involving bug investigation and troubleshooting.

  • Experience creating or improving processes is a strong advantage.

  • Good understanding of the bug lifecycle, testing principles, and troubleshooting techniques.

  • Ability to investigate technical issues, reproduce bugs, and write clear, structured bug reports.

  • Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, APIs, and client-server architecture.

  • Experience using Chrome DevTools, HAR files, and analyzing API requests.

  • Experience with Jira, Zendesk, Confluence, or similar tools.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and good communication skills.

  • Experience leading a Technical Support team is a strong advantage.

  • Very good English skills - a C1 level.

Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:

  • Full remote work.

  • Competitive compensation with a service contract.

  • Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments.

  • An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most.

  • Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage.

  • Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions.

  • A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team.

Recruitment Process:

  • Quick Video Interview (5-15 min).

  • Final interview with Hiring Manager.

  • Offer.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Growth Engineer
description:
TL;DR:
We’re looking for a full-stack engineer obsessed with Lovable’s growth engine - turning first touches into daily habits, and daily habits into a thriving ecosystem and real revenue. One sprint you’re shipping onboarding and activation flows; the next you’re crafting distribution rails and monetization features that help builders reach more users and keep them around. You think in React and APIs, but your first instinct is always: does this make users more successful, more often?

Coding skills + excellent taste + growth instincts + product obsession = you.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

What you’ll do

  • Ship and iterate activation, monetization and retention experiences that create fast, repeatable value and turn first-time users into long-term fans.

  • Build distribution rails for user apps: SEO and performance, shareable moments, social previews, email and lifecycle journeys, and other growth hooks.

  • Ship marketplace and ecosystem features for publishing, discovering, and reusing apps, templates, components, and services - plus profiles, reviews, and matching between builders and customers.

  • Design and implement monetization and pricing flows: payments, subscriptions, access control, plans, paywalls, billing integration, and revenue-share models that work for creators, customers, and Lovable.

  • Build the analytics and experimentation foundations - events, funnels, attribution, and A/B tests - so the team can understand what works and double down on it.

  • Collaborate closely with design, marketing, partnerships, and support to launch and grow new surfaces across the product and ecosystem.

  • Keep the experience relentlessly Lovable while making growth the engine, not the afterthought.

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM providers

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 230,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.

That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first.

As our new Paid Media Specialist, you'll plan, run, and optimize paid social advertising campaigns for Kinsta. You'll join our Performance Marketing team, report to the Paid Media Team Lead, and work closely with Demand Generation, Design, and RevOps to deliver a consistent volume of sign-ups and revenue that supports Kinsta's growth goals. It's a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable with data and enjoys testing new ideas.

Your focus is Kinsta's paid social presence across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms. You'll reach the businesses, agencies, and enterprises that run their sites on WordPress, through campaigns that cover the full funnel from awareness to customer acquisition.

You'll own campaigns from build to optimization, keep conversion tracking reliable, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. We work with teams across the globe, so you should be used to collaborating asynchronously and flexible enough to join the occasional early or late call. The ideal Kinsta Paid Media Specialist is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, proactive, and collaborative.

What You Will Do:

Plan, build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms, covering the full funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Monitor performance and continuously optimize targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, ad creatives, and landing pages, scaling what works while keeping acquisition costs efficient.

Run audience research and competitive analysis to find new opportunities for growth.

Develop and run A/B tests across ad messaging, creative assets, audiences, and landing pages.

Own conversion tracking: implement, maintain, and troubleshoot it through Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform-specific pixels and tags, and work with marketing and technical teams to keep conversion events and attribution accurate.

Analyze campaign performance using ad platform data, web analytics, and CRM reporting, and build reports and dashboards that share results and actionable insights.

Collaborate with content, design, product marketing, and sales on ad copy, creative concepts, and campaign assets that match our messaging and business priorities.

Support our paid media strategy: follow advertising trends and platform updates, and recommend ways to improve campaign efficiency, lead quality, and overall marketing ROI.

Use AI tools to streamline research, reporting, ad copy, and creative ideation, automate repetitive tasks, and apply critical thinking to AI-generated recommendations so decisions stay grounded in accurate data and business objectives.

What You Bring To The Role:

2-4 years of hands-on experience independently building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns, including on Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit, ideally in hosting, B2B technology, or a related industry.

Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags.

A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations.

Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once.

Bonus if you have:

Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms.

Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack.

Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites.

Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.

Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns

Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development.

Our Benefits:

Annual remote expense budget.

Flexible PTO.

Paid parental leave.

Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta.

Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter).

Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary.

Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA.

title: Avionics System Engineer - Navigation Sensors
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

As a Senior Navigation Sensors engineer, you will support the integration and testing of the Nyx navigation sensors – Inertial measurement Unit (IMU), GNSS Receiver, Star Tracker and LiDAR – ensuring seamless integration and performance of the Navigation Sensing Suite (NSS) functional chain.

Key Responsibilities

Navigation Sensor Systems Development

  • Take technical ownership of the spacecraft's navigation sensor suite, including requirements definition, architecture, component selection, and system-level performance.

  • Define and maintain sensor requirements, specifications, and interfaces in alignment with overall spacecraft mission and system requirements.

  • Assess sensor technologies, evaluate design trade-offs, and drive technical decisions to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and suitability for the mission.

  • Ensure proper integration of navigation sensors into the spacecraft avionics architecture.

Supplier and Component Management

  • Act as the technical focal point for navigation sensor suppliers throughout the component development lifecycle.

  • Coordinate technical reviews, manage supplier deliverables, and resolve technical issues throughout development and procurement.

Testing, Verification and Certification

  • Develop and maintain verification and qualification strategies for navigation sensor components and systems.

  • Define and review test plans, procedures, and acceptance criteria.

  • Coordinate and support component-level testing, environmental qualification, functional verification, and system integration testing.

  • Analyze test results, assess compliance with requirements, and drive resolution of identified anomalies.

  • Prepare and maintain verification evidence and technical documentation to support qualification, certification, and mission readiness.

  • Support reviews and technical interactions with customers, external stakeholders, and certification authorities.

GNC and Cross-Functional Integration

  • Work closely with the GNC team to define navigation sensor performance requirements and ensure alignment with spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control needs.

  • Collaborate on sensor selection, performance modeling, and system-level performance assessments.

  • Support the development and validation of sensor models and their integration into GNC algorithms and simulations.

  • Coordinate with other spacecraft engineering disciplines to ensure consistent interfaces and successful end-to-end system integration.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in avionics, spacecraft systems, navigation sensors, or aerospace systems engineering.

  • Experience developing, integrating, and verifying aerospace sensor systems.

  • Experience working with external suppliers on complex aerospace components.

  • Strong understanding of requirements engineering, system integration, verification, and qualification processes.

  • Experience defining and executing component-level and system-level test campaigns.

  • Ability to analyze technical data, evaluate sensor performance, and drive resolution of complex engineering problems.

  • Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering environments and coordinating technical activities across teams.

  • Good level of understanding of the following domains:

    • Navigation, Guidance and Control

    • Navigation sensors

    • Hardware testing

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with simulation and software development tools (e.g. Python, Github, C/C++).

  • Experience with spacecraft navigation sensors such as GNSS receivers, inertial measurement units (IMUs), accelerometers, gyroscopes, magnetometers, star trackers, or optical navigation sensors.

  • Experience with spacecraft or aircraft platforms.

  • Familiarity with GNC architectures, navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, and estimation techniques.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

title: Fluid Systems Development Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


Description

We are seeking a talented Fluid Systems Development Engineer to join the Storm engine project. As a key member of our System Team, you will play a central role in developing key fluid systems of the engine.

Key Responsibilities

As a Fluid Systems Development Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

  • Translate engine-level functional and performance requirements into fluid-system requirements, architectures, and development priorities.

  • Lead architecture trade-off studies, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments to support robust design decisions.

  • Define and manage the development roadmap for fluid-system sub-assemblies, from concept through maturation and qualification.

  • Lead the design of fluid systems and the selection, development, and integration of their components, including make-or-buy decisions.

  • Define and manage the verification and validation strategy, including requirements, test specifications, acceptance criteria, and evidence of compliance.

  • Design and specify the pneumatic equipment required to support demonstrator test campaigns and test-article operations.

  • Analyse test data to assess system performance, identify discrepancies, and validate and anchor fluid-system models.

  • Feed test results and lessons learned back into system design, requirements, and future development activities.


What we would love to see from you

  • Master's Degree or higher (or NZ and AUS "Bachelor with honors") in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related and applicable technical discipline. Alternatively, a bachelor's degree with substantial relevant experience

  • Minimum 2 years of proven experience developing propulsion fluid systems

  • Strong knowledge of fluid dynamics, thermodynamics and cryogenic fluids

  • Good knowledge of fluid components (check-valves, pressure regulators...)

  • Fluency in English; proficiency in German or French is an asset

  • Basic knowledge of aerospace standards (e.g. ECSS, NASA guidelines)

  • Experience writing scripts in Python

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to support hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK continues to scale globally.

This is a hands-on recruitment role for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple hiring priorities, and partnering closely with stakeholders to deliver hiring outcomes. You will have exposure to a wide range of functions including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, and other business-critical teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for assigned roles across multiple functions and locations.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, candidate profiles, and business priorities.

  • Source, screen, assess, and engage candidates through various channels including LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards, and direct outreach.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for both active and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping and market research to support hiring strategies.

  • Coordinate and manage interview processes while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Provide regular hiring updates and pipeline insights to hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Support recruitment process improvements, hiring initiatives, and employer branding activities where required.

  • Collaborate with recruiters, coordinators, and business leaders to achieve hiring goals across the organization.


The Right Fit Has

  • 2–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Executive Search, Staffing, or a related field.

  • Proven experience managing multiple vacancies simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong sourcing capabilities across LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, networking, and direct outreach.

  • Experience recruiting across multiple functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, or other corporate functions.

  • Strong candidate assessment and interviewing skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and execution.

  • Comfortable operating in an environment with evolving priorities and ambitious hiring goals.

  • Demonstrates ownership, resilience, adaptability, and a proactive mindset.

  • Experience in technology companies, startups, recruitment agencies, or high-growth organizations is highly preferred.

  • Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities such as Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, or Japanese are an advantage.


What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers strong candidate pipelines across multiple functions and markets.

  • Consistently achieves hiring targets while maintaining quality and candidate experience.

  • Builds trusted relationships with hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability throughout the recruitment process.

  • Contributes to improving recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and overall team performance.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and development opportunities.

  • Exposure to international hiring across multiple markets and functions.

  • Opportunity to work directly with experienced recruiters and business leaders.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and responsibility from day one.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

  • Meaningful work that directly contributes to the growth and success of the business.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

title: Flight Control Intern - Stabilizing Unstable Aircraft
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As a Flight Control Intern, you explore how far an aircraft can be pushed beyond natural stability, and what performance that buys. Instability makes aircraft more agile, but only if the control system can keep them flying. You own your project end to end: you choose and build unstable airframes, identify their dynamics from flight data, design the control that stabilizes them, and measure the limits of what can be achieved. You work on agile, high-performance platforms in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, flying frequently on a dedicated test range. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship.

Responsibilities
Select and justify unstable configurations to study, such as multirotor and VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), relaxed-stability fixed wings, and tailless, blended-wing or canard layouts.

  • Design and build the airframes yourself (foam, 3D printing, composites), integrate the avionics provided by the team, and repair after crashes.

  • Plan and run flight test campaigns with excitation maneuvers, and iterate quickly on a dedicated test range.

  • Identify the aircraft dynamics from flight data (system identification) and validate the models against analytical and simulated results.

  • Design and tune stabilizing controllers on PX4 or ArduPilot, then port them to Harmattan's in-house flight controller firmware.

  • Push the instability step by step, for example by moving the center of gravity aft or reducing control surfaces, and analyze stability margins.

  • Quantify the performance envelope, including the limits set by actuator bandwidth, sensor noise and latency, and the agility gained in return.

  • Build a reusable toolchain: a Python simulation workflow (for example JSBSim or Gazebo) validated on flight data, hardware-in-the-loop tests, flight test procedures and a data analysis pipeline.

  • Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects.

Candidate Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an MSc in Aerospace Engineering, Control, Robotics, or a related field.

  • Solid foundations in flight mechanics and control theory, ideally with experience in system identification or stability analysis.

  • Proficiency in Python. C/C++ and embedded firmware experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on building experience, such as RC aircraft, drones, or any fabrication project. Familiarity with PX4 or ArduPilot is a plus.

  • Comfort with flight testing, debugging in the field, and learning from the occasional crash.

  • Motivated, autonomous, and proactive, with the ability to own a project and communicate results clearly.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Inertial Navigation Engineer Intern
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing advanced autonomous systems that rely on robust state estimation and sensor fusion to operate in complex, dynamic environments. Our platforms integrate multiple sensors (e.g., IMU, GNSS, vision, barometer, magnetometer) and require accurate, real-time estimation of system states (position, velocity, attitude, etc).

Classical approaches such as Kalman filtering are powerful but rely on modeling assumptions that often break down in real-world conditions. To push performance beyond these limits, we are exploring hybrid approaches that combine model-based estimation with modern machine learning techniques.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to explore and apply machine learning-based sensor fusion and state estimation methods to improve performance in dynamic environments.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Conduct a comprehensive review of existing ML methods for state estimation and sensor fusion.

  • Algorithm Implementation: Develop and implement various algorithms based on the literature review and project requirements using simulated and real-world flight data.

  • Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and computational overhead of the developed algorithms with classical baselines.

  • Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

  • Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results, and conclusions.

  • Flight Tests Participation: Actively participate in flight test sessions to gather real-world data and validate the effectiveness of the developed algorithms in operational conditions. Contribute to real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record in applied mathematics, machine learning, robotics or a related fied. Knowledge of sensor fusion/state estimation is a strong plus.

  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of ML fundamentals. Experience with State Estimation, drones, or Control Theory is a major plus.

  • Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

This role will initially focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners, low TRL research with government agencies, to direct collaboration with military units. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

You will work in our team of experienced 3D computer graphics engineers, 3D vision engineers, and robotics engineers. You will not just work on some unimportant side project, but you might actually build key parts of solutions that will be used by our customers and partners. At Fiducial, graphics is not just about pretty pictures: our rendering, simulation, and GPU pipelines sit directly at the heart of our perception and autonomy systems. Activities include:

  • Building physically-based and multi-spectral rendering and simulation pipelines (e.g. EO and thermal/IR camera simulation) to generate realistic synthetic imagery and test perception algorithms across environments and conditions

  • Developing real-time 3D visualization and flight-analysis tools for inspecting reconstructed 3D flight paths, live sensor data, multi-camera detections, and point clouds

  • Working on real-time 3D reconstruction and novel rendering representations such as Gaussian splatting and multi-camera / LiDAR point-cloud mapping

  • Building real-time terrain and satellite rendering pipelines that run directly in the loop with our visual positioning and navigation algorithms

  • Writing and optimizing GPU compute and rendering workloads (shaders, CUDA, and low-level graphics APIs) to run efficiently on both desktop and low-cost embedded hardware

What we expect from you

  • Experience with real-time software development such as game, rendering, simulation, or embedded development

  • Solid grasp of 3D computer graphics fundamentals (rendering pipelines, 3D math and transforms, shaders, ray/path tracing, or rasterization)

  • Experience with graphics or GPU compute APIs (such as OpenGL, Vulkan, WebGPU/WGSL, DirectX, or CUDA)

  • Experience with 3D scene representations or reconstruction techniques such as meshes, voxels, point clouds, or Gaussian splatting

  • Experience with modern C++ (experience with Rust is also welcome)

Big plus if you’re strong in 3D computer vision. Because our graphics work is tightly coupled with our perception stack, strong vision fundamentals will let you have an even bigger impact:

  • Familiarity with camera models, projective and epipolar geometry, camera calibration, or PnP, which is useful when matching simulated or rendered views directly to real cameras

  • Experience with 3D reconstruction or mapping pipelines such as COLMAP, photogrammetry, Structure-from-Motion (SfM), SLAM, or visual odometry

  • Interest or experience in applying rendering and GPU compute to vision problems like long-range drone detection, satellite-to-camera matching, or depth estimation

General

  • Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws

About the Role:

As a User Communications Intern on the Binance User Comms team, you will help shape how millions of Chinese-speaking users experience Binance. You will review and refine the Chinese announcements and FAQs that business units publish to a global audience; ensuring every piece reads natively, and that it meets Binance's standards for accuracy, clarity, and tone. Your reviews will catch discrepancies against English source content before they reach users, and your feedback will help build the glossaries, guidelines, and AI-assisted tooling that raise the bar for Chinese content across the company.   • Meticulous and detail-oriented; announcements are dense with dates, numbers, and product details, and small errors matter.

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted writing and productivity tools to support reviews.
  • Stay up to date with trending topics on social media.

title: Optomechanical Design Engineer — Precision CNC Parts
description:
Role Title: Optomechanical Design Engineer — Precision CNC Parts (Remote)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Fully remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $90 -$155/hour

Duration: Initial phase of 20 part packages; production phase to follow

Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions

You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software

Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineers

micro1 is engaging senior optomechanical and mechanical design engineers to create original CAD part packages for a client project in precision optics and optomechanics. Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well.

What you'll do

  1. Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP.
  2. Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard.
  3. Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale.
  4. Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate.
  5. Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score.

This is a review and authoring role. It does not involve treating patients, and no real patient data is used.

Requirements

Credentials

  1. BSN (or ADN with substantial relevant experience) with an active, unrestricted US RN license (single-state or multistate compact).

  2. Inpatient medical-surgical, orthopedic surgery, PACU, wound-care, or home health nursing experience; specialty certification preferred (for example CWOCN, CWCN, CMSRN, ONC, or CPAN).

Requirements

  1. Based in the United States, with an active, unrestricted US license or professional credential in good standing.

  2. Trained and currently practicing (or actively auditing clinical documentation and claims) in the US health system.

  3. 5+ years of post-qualification clinical practice or certified medical coding/CDI auditing experience, with direct patient care or active US chart/claims auditing within the last 2 years.

  4. Working knowledge of current US clinical or coding guidelines in your field (for example USPSTF, ACC/AHA, ADA, APA, APTA, ASHP, WOCN Society, AMA CPT/E&M, CMS, ICD-10-CM/PCS, and AAPC/AHIMA) and the habit of checking them rather than relying on memory.

  5. Clear written English; able to explain a clinical or coding judgment in two or three plain sentences.

  6. Comfortable with spreadsheets and web-based review tools.

  7. Able to work on written instructions and accept feedback from calibration reviews.

Scope

  1. Protocol-driven post-operative monitoring and symptom triage (including orthopedic spine and ACL recovery check-ins): vital signs, early warning scores, pain severity, fever thresholds, swelling trajectory, mobility, nausea, fluid balance, bleeding, urinary retention, and ileus.

  2. Recognition and timely escalation of acute deterioration: sepsis, hemorrhage, PE/DVT, surgical site infection, anastomotic leak, and compartment syndrome.

  3. Wound and pressure-injury assessment and care planning (including clinical photography review): surgical wounds, dehiscence, Deep Tissue Injury (DTI) without skin breakdown, NPIAP staging, offloading, perfusion checks, diabetic foot and venous ulcers, dressing selection, and negative-pressure therapy.

  4. Drains, catheters, ostomies, peripheral IV cannulation, lines, and tubes.

  5. Structured inpatient nursing care plans and documentation (assessment, standardized nursing diagnoses such as NANDA/NIC/NOC, outcomes, interventions, and shift SOAP evaluations).

  6. Medication administration safety, patient and caregiver discharge teaching, and clear scope-of-practice boundaries (independent nursing actions vs. prescriber escalation).

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!

  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!

We are seeking a highly motivated Business Development Representative to join our team and accelerate their career in sales.

In this role, you will be responsible for qualifying prospects, assessing their business goals, and determining if their needs align with our product capabilities and convert prospective customers into an opportunity for a meeting with an Account Executive.

The ideal candidate should be confident in their ability to communicate effectively and build relationships with potential customers.   • Commitment ; a strong desire to pursue a career in sales
  • Consistent track record of overachieving

  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
